text:
maria.prodeng: Quick heads-up — tomorrow we’ll publish a billing policy update that affects the free tier and invoice format. Please read and share in your teams.

billing-bot: [Automated] Draft published to #announcements-drafts: https://redwood.internal/billing/2026-new-billing-format (preview access)

dave.billing: TL;DR: free trial credits for new org signups end on 2026-04-15. Existing active trials are grandfathered until their current expiry. We’re also standardizing invoice line-items to separate token, embedding, and storage charges.

maria.prodeng: Important: this is a policy change, not a pricing increase. It’s to simplify billing and reduce unexpected overage cases.

cfo.sara: We ran the impact model — ~7% of active self-serve orgs use only the free trial and are expected to churn if we remove credits; we plan a targeted email + 3 month discount offer for qualifying customers.

engops.tyler: Ops note: rate-limit soft thresholds will also shift. We’ll move to a two-tier soft-limit model: soft warnings at 80% of quota, enforced soft-cap (throttle) at 120% for public-hosted accounts. Dedicated customers unaffected.

dave.billing: Action items for teams:
- Product: update self-serve signup flow to show new "no free credits after 2026-04-15" messaging.
- Support: new canned responses + refund guidance.
- Sales/CS: new 3-month 50% discount voucher to offer to impacted customers.
- Eng: make invoice CSV include columns: invoice_id, line_type, usage_units, unit_price, region_code.

maria.prodeng: Support and legal reviewed comms. Legal asked us to add an FAQ item about credits and data retention.

billing-bot: Example CSV diff (preview):
```
-old: invoice_line,description,amount
-new: invoice_id,line_type,usage_units,unit_price,amount,region_code
```

engops.tyler: For rollout, plan is: internal comms today, public blog + support articles tomorrow, emails to affected orgs on 2026-04-01.

dave.billing: Everyone — please avoid public-facing language like "we’re canceling free trials". Use: "we are updating our free trial program to better align with long-term product changes".

cfo.sara: Finance will update accounting mappings. There will be a short downtime window for invoice export schema migration on 2026-04-08 03:00-04:00 UTC — export jobs may fail; notify customers.

maria.prodeng: Raising a quick question for eng: is there any blocker to adding `region_code` to current invoice export?

engops.tyler: No blocker, but CSV consumers should expect an extra column and a semver bump to the export schema. We’ll add a header `schema_version=2` to the top of files.

dave.billing: Support sample reply for CS: "Your current credits will remain valid through your original expiry date. New signups after Apr 15 will not receive automatic free credits; we are offering an onboarding discount for eligible teams."

maria.prodeng: Any objections to sending the 4/1 mail on Friday EOD PST?

cfo.sara: Fine by me, but make sure draft is approved by legal and finance by EOD Thursday.

maria.prodeng: Noted. I’ll coordinate reviews and post the final copy here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: [Automated] Assigned: @dave.billing (owner), @maria.prodeng (comms), @engops.tyler (ops)

engops.tyler: One more flag — please update SDK changelog with billing-related fields so customers reading programmatic exports know about `line_type` and `region_code`.

dave.billing: Will do. I’ll add a short migration guide and sample code snippet for parsing the new CSV in python/js.

maria.prodeng: OK closing the loop — posting the final announcement at 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC unless anyone raises a blocking concern here by EOD.

support.jen (in thread): Quick question — for trials created via partners, are they impacted?

dave.billing: Partner-created trials: partners can still grant custom credits. The platform default will change. We’ll notify partner teams separately.

maria.prodeng: Thanks everyone — will upload the final copy and the FAQ link here once ready.
